## Load the package
```{r}
library(ClonoMappeR)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

## Get example query data
```{r}
v1pos <- get_reference(context = "SarsCoV2", org = "human") %>%
  filter(publication == "GSE219098" & binding == TRUE & str_detect(name, "v1D14") & str_detect(name, "pike"))
v1neg <- get_reference(context = "SarsCoV2", org = "human") %>%
  filter(publication == "GSE219098" & binding == FALSE & str_detect(name, "v1D14") & str_detect(name, "pike"))
head(v1pos)
head(v1neg)
```

```{r}
v2pos <- get_reference(context = "SarsCoV2", org = "human") %>%
  filter(publication == "GSE219098" & binding == TRUE & !str_detect(name, "v1D14") & str_detect(name, "pike"))
v2neg <- get_reference(context = "SarsCoV2", org = "human") %>%
  filter(publication == "GSE219098" & binding == FALSE & !str_detect(name, "v1D14") & str_detect(name, "pike"))
head(v2pos)
head(v2neg)
```

## Detect BCRs with heavy chain V, J genes and CDR3

### Example 1 (S2+/- vs S2+ at v1)
```{r}
output1_v1neg_vs_v1pos <- find_publicBCR(
  query = v1neg,                                 # query dataframe
  reference = v1pos,                         # reference dataframe
  dist_method = c("levenshtein"),     # CDR3 distance calculation method
  CDRH3 = "CDRH3",                     # Required; column name that stores CDRH3 amino acid sequence
  VH = "VH",                        # Optional; column name that stores heavy chain V gene usage
  JH = "JH",                        # Optional; column name that stores heavy chain J gene usage
  output_dir = "test/example1",                     # Optional; directory to store output file
  output_name = "v1neg_vs_v1pos",                     # Optional; name of the output file
  ncores = 13                                    # Optional; number of cores for parallel processing
) %>%
  mutate(type = "v1neg_vs_v1pos")

output1_v2neg_vs_v1pos <- find_publicBCR(
  query = v2neg,                                 # query dataframe
  reference = v1pos,                         # reference dataframe
  dist_method = c("levenshtein"),     # CDR3 distance calculation method
  CDRH3 = "CDRH3",                     # Required; column name that stores CDRH3 amino acid sequence
  VH = "VH",                        # Optional; column name that stores heavy chain V gene usage
  JH = "JH",                        # Optional; column name that stores heavy chain J gene usage
  output_dir = "test/example1",                     # Optional; directory to store output file
  output_name = "v1neg_vs_v1pos",                     # Optional; name of the output file
  ncores = 13                                    # Optional; number of cores for parallel processing
) %>%
  mutate(type = "v2neg_vs_v1pos")

output1_v2pos_vs_v1pos <- find_publicBCR(
  query = v2pos,                                 # query dataframe
  reference = v1pos,                         # reference dataframe
  dist_method = c("levenshtein"),     # CDR3 distance calculation method
  CDRH3 = "CDRH3",                     # Required; column name that stores CDRH3 amino acid sequence
  VH = "VH",                        # Optional; column name that stores heavy chain V gene usage
  JH = "JH",                        # Optional; column name that stores heavy chain J gene usage
  output_dir = "test/example1",                     # Optional; directory to store output file
  output_name = "v2pos_vs_v1pos",                     # Optional; name of the output file
  ncores = 13                                  # Optional; number of cores for parallel processing
) %>%
  mutate(type = "v2pos_vs_v1pos")
```

```{r}
plot1 <- rbind(output1_v1neg_vs_v1pos, output1_v2pos_vs_v1pos, output1_v2neg_vs_v1pos) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CDRH3_dist, y = type)) +
  geom_density_ridges(aes(fill = type), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.1, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("test/example1/plot1.png", plot1, width = 6, height = 3)
print(plot1)
```

```{r}
rbind(output1_v1neg_vs_v1pos, output1_v2pos_vs_v1pos, output1_v2neg_vs_v1pos) %>%
  mutate(
    binder = ifelse(CDRH3_dist <= 0.1 & !is.na(CDRH3_dist), "overlap", "no overlap")
  ) %>%
  group_by(type, binder) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))
```


## Example 2 (Plasmablast vs S2+/- at v1)
```{r}
v1pb <- read.csv("inst/extdata/GSE219098_Plasmablast_v1D14.csv")
head(v1pb)
```

```{r}
output2_v1pb_vs_pos <- find_publicBCR(
  query = v1pb,                                 # query dataframe
  reference = rbind(v1pos, v2pos),                         # reference dataframe
  dist_method = c("levenshtein"),     # CDR3 distance calculation method
  CDRH3 = "CDRH3",                     # Required; column name that stores CDRH3 amino acid sequence
  VH = "VH",                        # Optional; column name that stores heavy chain V gene usage
  JH = "JH",                        # Optional; column name that stores heavy chain J gene usage
  CDRL3 = NA,                                    # Optional; column name that stores CDRL3 amino acid sequence
  VL = NA,                                       # Optional; column name that stores light chain V gene usage
  JL = NA,                                       # Optional; column name that stores light chain J gene usage
  output_dir = "test/example2",                     # Optional; directory to store output file
  output_name = "v1pb_vs_pos",                     # Optional; name of the output file
  ncores = 10                                    # Optional; number of cores for parallel processing
) %>%
  mutate(type = "v1pb_vs_pos")

output2_v1pb_vs_neg <- find_publicBCR(
  query = v1pb,                                 # query dataframe
  reference = rbind(v1neg, v2neg),                         # reference dataframe
  dist_method = c("levenshtein"),     # CDR3 distance calculation method
  CDRH3 = "CDRH3",                     # Required; column name that stores CDRH3 amino acid sequence
  VH = "VH",                        # Optional; column name that stores heavy chain V gene usage
  JH = "JH",                        # Optional; column name that stores heavy chain J gene usage
  CDRL3 = NA,                                    # Optional; column name that stores CDRL3 amino acid sequence
  VL = NA,                                       # Optional; column name that stores light chain V gene usage
  JL = NA,                                       # Optional; column name that stores light chain J gene usage
  output_dir = "test/example2",                     # Optional; directory to store output file
  output_name = "v1pb_vs_neg",                     # Optional; name of the output file
  ncores = 10                                    # Optional; number of cores for parallel processing
) %>%
  mutate(type = "v1pb_vs_neg")
```

```{r}
plot2 <- rbind(output2_v1pb_vs_pos, output2_v1pb_vs_neg) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CDRH3_dist, y = type)) +
  geom_density_ridges(aes(fill = type), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.1, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("test/example2/plot2.png", plot2, width = 6, height = 3)
print(plot2)
```

```{r}
rbind(output2_v1pb_vs_pos, output2_v1pb_vs_neg) %>%
  mutate(
    binder = ifelse(CDRH3_dist <= 0.1 & !is.na(CDRH3_dist), "overlap", "no overlap")
  ) %>%
  group_by(type, binder) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))
```

## Example 3 (S2+ from GSE219098 vs S2+ from GSE252959)

